name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College Students
provider: Department of Higher Education (Ministry of Education)
income_limit: Family income below ₹4.5 Lakh per annum
eligibility: Students above 80th percentile in Class 12 board examination pursuing regular degree courses.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls (Technical Degree & Diploma)
name_hi: एआईसीटीई प्रगति छात्रवृत्ति (बेटियों के लिए तकनीकी शिक्षा)
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
target_group: Female Students in 1st year B.Tech / Engineering Diploma
amount: ₹50,000 per year towards tuition fees & laptop/books
income_limit: Family income below ₹8.0 Lakh per annum
eligibility: Maximum 2 girl children per family admitted to AICTE approved technical institutions.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC / ST / OBC Students
name_hi: अनुसूचित जाति/जनजाति एवं पिछड़ा वर्ग उत्तर-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
provider: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment / Respective State Govts
target_group: Students pursuing Class 11, 12, ITI, Polytechnic, UG, Medical, Engineering
amount: 100% Tuition Fee Reimbursement + Monthly Maintenance Allowance of ₹4,000 - ₹13,500/yr
income_limit: Family income below ₹2.5 Lakh per annum (SC/ST) or ₹2.0 Lakh (OBC)
eligibility: SC, ST, and OBC domicile students enrolled in recognized schools, colleges, or ITIs.
state: State-specific (UP, Bihar, MP, Rajasthan, Maharashtra etc.)
portal_name: NSP / State Scholarship Portals (UP Saksham, Medhasoft Bihar)

name: Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme (BSCCS)
name_hi: बिहार स्टूडेंट क्रेडिट कार्ड योजना (4 लाख तक शिक्षा ऋण)
target_group: 12th Pass students pursuing Higher & Professional Education
income_limit: No income ceiling! Available to all Bihar residents
eligibility: 12th pass students under 25 years admitted in approved 40+ degree courses (B.Tech, BCA, B.Sc Nursing, Hotel Mgmt, etc.)

name: Vidya Lakshmi Portal - Centralized Govt Education Loan Portal
name_hi: विद्या लक्ष्मी पोर्टल - सरकारी बैंकों से आसान शिक्षा ऋण
provider: NSDL e-Governance & Ministry of Finance, Govt of India
amount: Up to ₹7.5 Lakhs (Zero Collateral, Zero Third-Party Guarantee under CSIS scheme)
income_limit: Interest subsidy available for family income < ₹4.5 Lakhs (CSIS)
eligibility: Indian national secured admission to higher education course in India or abroad through entrance test/merit.

name: HDFC Bank Badhte Kadam Scholarship 2026
target_group: Students in Class 11, 12, General UG & Professional Courses
income_limit: Annual family income less than ₹6.0 Lakhs
eligibility: Students who passed previous exam with at least 60% marks; preference given to students facing family crisis/disabilities.

name: Vidyasaarathi Corporate Education Scholarships
provider: NSDL e-Gov Vidyasaarathi Platform (ACC, JSW, Tata, Protean)
eligibility: Minimum 50-60% marks in 10th or 12th; targeted towards children of daily wage workers, marginal farmers, and gig workers.

name: Ishan Uday Special Scholarship for North Eastern Region (NER)
name_hi: ईशान उदय विशेष छात्रवृत्ति (पूर्वोत्तर राज्यों के लिए)
target_group: Students with domicile in Assam, Arunachal, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, Tripura
income_limit: Family income below ₹4.5 Lakhs per year
eligibility: 10,000 scholarships distributed annually to NE region students enrolled in 1st year UG courses.
